newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's BUX seen breaking 6,000pts on Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's BUX seen breaking 6,000pts on Dow rally.

text.p: 0805 GMT - Hungarian share prices are expected to firm on Wednesday, traders said, and the BUX index might break the 6,000 points level, setting a new record high.
* However, they added, the pace of rise will not be as sharp as on the U.S. market because the BUX already firmed almost two percent on Tuesday.
* On Tuesday the BUX index finished at a record high of 5,952.92 points, up 103.51.
The Budapest Stock Exchange's BUX index might set a second successive record high on Wednesday and break the 6,000 point level for the first time ever, traders said.
"We'll set a new all-time high and I guess, I can say we'll break the 6,000 points," said Geza Raner of Bank Austria Investment Rt.
Traders said the surge on Wall Street will have a positive impact on the Hungarian market, even though the bourse's rise may not be too strong following a rise of almost two percent on Tuesday.
"The Hungarian market will benefit from the Dow's rally, although we might not rise that sharply," said Tamas Petheo of Buda-Cash Brokerhaz.
Among central European exchanges the Budapest bourse is the most exposed to movements on Wall Street due to the high proportion of foreign investors.
But traders said other factors will also contribute to the rise.
"Roadshows are underway abroad, turning investors' attention to Hungary," Raner said.
Oil company MOL and tile maker Zalakeramia already started their roadshows while pharmaceuticals Richter will start next week.
On Tuesday the BUX index finished at a new record high of 5,952.92 points, up 103.51.
